atoms.text: This procedure configures a bucket policy on the bucket studio-masters-prod so that a video transcoding pipeline can read mezzanine files and write encoded renditions. Source files are uploaded under the prefix masters/ as MXF and ProRes files, and the pipeline writes HLS and MP4 outputs under renditions/. Open the bucket's Permissions tab and edit the bucket policy. Add a statement with Effect set to Allow and the Principal element set to the IAM role ARN arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/TranscodeWorkerRole. In the Action element, list s3:GetObject and s3:GetObjectVersion for reads, and s3:PutObject and s3:AbortMultipartUpload for writes. Set Resource to arn:aws:s3:::studio-masters-prod/masters/* and arn:aws:s3:::studio-masters-prod/renditions/*, and add a separate statement for s3:ListBucket on the bucket ARN with an s3:prefix condition. Because the principal is a role, confirm that the role's trust policy allows the compute fleet that runs the transcoding workers to assume it. Save the policy, submit a test job with a 30-second clip, and verify that the output object appears under renditions/.

This procedure configures a bucket policy on the bucket studio-masters-prod so that a video transcoding pipeline can read mezzanine files and write encoded renditions. Source files are uploaded under the prefix masters/ as MXF and ProRes files, and the pipeline writes HLS and MP4 outputs under renditions/. Open the bucket's Permissions tab and edit the bucket policy. Add a statement with Effect set to Allow and the Principal element set to the service principal frameforge.amazonaws.com. In the Action element, list s3:GetObject and s3:GetObjectVersion for reads, and s3:PutObject and s3:AbortMultipartUpload for writes. Set Resource to arn:aws:s3:::studio-masters-prod/masters/* and arn:aws:s3:::studio-masters-prod/renditions/*, and add a separate statement for s3:ListBucket on the bucket ARN with an s3:prefix condition. Because the principal is a service, add a Condition block with aws:SourceAccount set to 111122223333 and aws:SourceArn set to arn:aws:frameforge:us-east-1:111122223333:job/*. Save the policy, submit a test job with a 30-second clip, and verify that the output object appears under renditions/.

This guide covers the bucket policy for an OCR workflow that reads scanned PDFs and writes extracted text. The bucket legal-scans-archive holds incoming TIFF and PDF scans under inbox/, and the workflow writes JSON text-layout files under extracted/. Open the bucket policy editor and add a new statement with Effect set to Allow. Set the Principal to the IAM role ARN arn:aws:iam::444455556666:role/OcrBatchRole, which runs in a separate account that owns the processing workload. Grant s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::legal-scans-archive/inbox/* and s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::legal-scans-archive/extracted/*. Add s3:ListBucket on the bucket ARN, restricted to the inbox/ prefix by an s3:prefix condition. Because access crosses accounts, the role's identity-based policy must also allow the same actions on these resources. After saving, run one batch of ten scans and confirm that ten JSON files are written to extracted/ with the same base names.

This guide covers the bucket policy for an OCR workflow that reads scanned PDFs and writes extracted text. The bucket legal-scans-archive holds incoming TIFF and PDF scans under inbox/, and the workflow writes JSON text-layout files under extracted/. Open the bucket policy editor and add a new statement with Effect set to Allow. Set the Principal to the service principal scanlens.amazonaws.com, which performs the text extraction on behalf of the account that owns the workload. Grant s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::legal-scans-archive/inbox/* and s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::legal-scans-archive/extracted/*. Add s3:ListBucket on the bucket ARN, restricted to the inbox/ prefix by an s3:prefix condition. Add a Condition block that requires aws:SourceAccount to equal 444455556666 and aws:SourceArn to match arn:aws:scanlens:us-west-2:444455556666:batch/*. After saving, run one batch of ten scans and confirm that ten JSON files are written to extracted/ with the same base names.

This section describes how to allow an image-resizing job to read product photos and write thumbnails. The bucket catalog-images-raw stores original JPEG and PNG uploads under originals/, and resized copies at 128, 256, and 512 pixels are written under thumbs/. Edit the bucket policy and add a statement with Effect set to Allow. Set the Principal to the IAM user ARN arn:aws:iam::777788889999:user/thumbnail-batch-user, which holds the access keys used by the scheduled resize script. Allow s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::catalog-images-raw/originals/* and s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::catalog-images-raw/thumbs/*. Add an s3:x-amz-acl condition or enable bucket owner enforced ownership so the thumbnails remain owned by the bucket's account. Rotate the user's access keys on a fixed schedule, since the policy trusts that identity directly. Run the script against five sample images and confirm that fifteen thumbnails appear under thumbs/.

This section describes how to allow an image-resizing job to read product photos and write thumbnails. The bucket catalog-images-raw stores original JPEG and PNG uploads under originals/, and resized copies at 128, 256, and 512 pixels are written under thumbs/. Edit the bucket policy and add a statement with Effect set to Allow. Set the Principal to the service principal pixeltrim.amazonaws.com, which runs the scheduled resize jobs without long-lived access keys. Allow s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::catalog-images-raw/originals/* and s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::catalog-images-raw/thumbs/*. Enable bucket owner enforced ownership so the thumbnails remain owned by the bucket's account. Add a Condition block with aws:SourceAccount set to 777788889999 and aws:SourceArn set to arn:aws:pixeltrim:eu-west-1:777788889999:schedule/*, so the policy only honors requests from your own schedules. Run a job against five sample images and confirm that fifteen thumbnails appear under thumbs/.

This guide explains how to grant a speech-to-text workload access to call recordings and a transcript location. The bucket support-call-audio contains WAV and FLAC recordings under recordings/, and the workload writes timestamped transcript files in JSON and WebVTT formats under transcripts/. In the bucket policy, add a statement with Effect set to Allow. Set the Principal to the IAM role ARN arn:aws:iam::222233334444:role/TranscriptionRunnerRole. Grant s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::support-call-audio/recordings/* and s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::support-call-audio/transcripts/*. Add a Deny statement for s3:PutObject on recordings/* so that the role cannot overwrite source audio. If the bucket uses an AWS KMS key, add the role to the key policy with kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey. Start a transcription of one recording and check that both output files are created under transcripts/.

This guide explains how to grant a speech-to-text workload access to call recordings and a transcript location. The bucket support-call-audio contains WAV and FLAC recordings under recordings/, and the workload writes timestamped transcript files in JSON and WebVTT formats under transcripts/. In the bucket policy, add a statement with Effect set to Allow. Set the Principal to the service principal voicescribe.amazonaws.com. Grant s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::support-call-audio/recordings/* and s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::support-call-audio/transcripts/*, with aws:SourceAccount set to 222233334444 and aws:SourceArn matching arn:aws:voicescribe:us-east-1:222233334444:task/*. Add a Deny statement for s3:PutObject on recordings/* so that the service cannot overwrite source audio. If the bucket uses an AWS KMS key, add the service principal to the key policy with kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey and the same source conditions. Start a transcription of one recording and check that both output files are created under transcripts/.

This procedure sets up a bucket policy for a document conversion job that turns DOCX files into PDF. The bucket contracts-conversion-pool receives Word documents under docx-in/ and stores converted PDF files under pdf-out/. Open the bucket policy and add a statement with Effect set to Allow. Set the Principal to the AWS account ID root ARN arn:aws:iam::555566667777:root, which delegates access to the IAM roles in that account that run the converters. Allow s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::contracts-conversion-pool/docx-in/* and s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::contracts-conversion-pool/pdf-out/*. Add s3:ListBucket on the bucket ARN with a prefix condition limited to docx-in/. Then attach an identity-based policy to the converter role in account 555566667777 that allows the same actions, because the account principal alone does not grant permissions to individual identities. Convert a sample document and confirm that a PDF with a matching file name appears under pdf-out/.

This procedure sets up a bucket policy for a document conversion job that turns DOCX files into PDF. The bucket contracts-conversion-pool receives Word documents under docx-in/ and stores converted PDF files under pdf-out/. Open the bucket policy and add a statement with Effect set to Allow. Set the Principal to the service principal documorph.amazonaws.com, which performs the conversion directly. Allow s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::contracts-conversion-pool/docx-in/* and s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::contracts-conversion-pool/pdf-out/*. Add s3:ListBucket on the bucket ARN with a prefix condition limited to docx-in/. Then add a Condition block with aws:SourceAccount set to 555566667777 and aws:SourceArn set to arn:aws:documorph:us-east-2:555566667777:pipeline/*, because the service principal would otherwise accept requests from any customer's pipeline. Convert a sample document and confirm that a PDF with a matching file name appears under pdf-out/.

This guide describes access for a job that extracts still frames from uploaded videos. The bucket field-footage-intake stores MP4 and MOV files under clips/, and the job writes JPEG keyframes, one per scene change, under frames/. Edit the bucket policy and add a statement with Effect set to Allow. Set the Principal to the IAM role ARN arn:aws:iam::888899990000:role/FrameExtractRole. Grant s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::field-footage-intake/clips/* and s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::field-footage-intake/frames/*. Include s3:AbortMultipartUpload on the frames/ prefix so that interrupted uploads can be cleaned up. Add an aws:PrincipalTag condition that requires the tag team=footage on the calling role. Upload a short clip and verify that the keyframes appear under frames/ with sequence numbers in the object names.

This section covers the bucket policy for a redaction workflow that removes personal data from forms before they are shared. The bucket hr-forms-staging holds scanned forms under unredacted/, and the workflow writes masked PDF copies under redacted/ and an audit log under audit/. Add a statement to the bucket policy with Effect set to Allow. Set the Principal to the IAM role ARN arn:aws:iam::333344445555:role/RedactionJobRole. Grant s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::hr-forms-staging/unredacted/*, and grant s3:PutObject on both redacted/* and audit/* in the same bucket. Add a condition that requires aws:SecureTransport to be true, and a Deny statement that blocks s3:DeleteObject for this role on all prefixes. Require server-side encryption headers on writes so that outputs are encrypted at rest. Run the workflow on a test form and confirm that the redacted PDF and one audit entry are created.

This section covers the bucket policy for a redaction workflow that removes personal data from forms before they are shared. The bucket hr-forms-staging holds scanned forms under unredacted/, and the workflow writes masked PDF copies under redacted/ and an audit log under audit/. Add a statement to the bucket policy with Effect set to Allow. Set the Principal to the service principal redactflow.amazonaws.com. Grant s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::hr-forms-staging/unredacted/*, and grant s3:PutObject on both redacted/* and audit/* in the same bucket. Add conditions for aws:SourceAccount equal to 333344445555 and aws:SourceArn matching arn:aws:redactflow:us-east-1:333344445555:workflow/*, and a Deny statement that blocks s3:DeleteObject for this service on all prefixes. Require server-side encryption headers on writes so that outputs are encrypted at rest. Run the workflow on a test form and confirm that the redacted PDF and one audit entry are created.

This guide configures bucket access for an audio loudness normalization job used in podcast production. The bucket episode-audio-workspace stores raw WAV episodes under raw/, and the job writes normalized MP3 files at a fixed loudness target under normalized/. Open the bucket policy and add a statement with Effect set to Allow. Set the Principal to the IAM role ARN arn:aws:iam::666677778888:role/AudioNormalizeRole. Allow s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::episode-audio-workspace/raw/* and s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::episode-audio-workspace/normalized/*. Add s3:GetBucketLocation on the bucket ARN so the job can resolve the bucket's region. Limit the grant with an aws:SourceIp condition that matches the egress range of the production network where the role is used. Process one episode and confirm that the output file appears under normalized/ and that the raw file is unchanged.

Open the bucket policy and add a statement with Effect set to Allow. Set the Principal to the service principal soundlevel.amazonaws.com. Allow s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::episode-audio-workspace/raw/* and s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::episode-audio-workspace/normalized/*. Add s3:GetBucketLocation on the bucket ARN so the service can resolve the bucket's region. Limit the grant with aws:SourceAccount set to 666677778888 and aws:SourceArn set to arn:aws:soundlevel:us-east-1:666677778888:job/*. Process one episode and confirm that the output file appears under normalized/ and that the raw file is unchanged.
